description: Ministry of Labour and Trade Union Relations - Award made to the Industrial Dispute between Mrs. S. M. D. Jayasundara and National Housing Development Authority (E only)
categorisation: This gazette content primarily concerns the publication of an arbitration award under the Industrial Disputes Act, which falls under legal/regulatory matters. It involves the settlement of an industrial dispute through established legal procedures, references specific sections of legislation, and represents a formal legal determination. This fits Type 5 (Legal/Regulatory Gazettes) as it deals with regulatory frameworks, legal proceedings, and statutory instruments rather than government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
